_meta.description: Fill Stripe's 'Create restricted API key' form for Mike's AI team: name the key and set eight permissions (Products, Prices, Payment Links, Webhook Endpoints = Write; Checkout Sessions, Events, Charges and Refunds, Balance = Read), everything else None. STOPS before 'Create key': a human clicks it, copies the key, and stores it in Keychain. The key value never passes through Yeshie.
_meta.verificationNotes: Built 2026-10-12 by Claude Opus 5.5 (session ac7c4516) from the live form on Eric Kohner & Co. LLC's account. Permission rows are <tr> with the label in the first <td> and div[role=button].db-SegmentedControlOption options None/Read/Write. Some labels appear twice (group row + resource row, e.g. 'Payment Links', 'Checkout Sessions'); the step sets every matching row. Balance and Events offer only None/Read. v1.1: the 'js' action only runs whitelisted patterns, and 'respond' needs a data map, so permissions are now eight 'click' steps with within_row cells (exact label), selecting option 2 (Read) or 3 (Write). v1.2: steps v1-v8 prove each permission is selected (fail closed).

account_id.description: Stripe account id, e.g. acct_1U1riW241pTwoRhz (Eric Kohner & Co. LLC)

key_name.description: Name shown in Stripe's key list

mode.description: 'live' or 'test'. For test mode the URL uses /test/apikeys/create.

_meta.humanGate: Create key, copy key, store in Keychain

create_key_button.description: Create key submit button. Yeshie never clicks it.

chain.note: Live mode. For test mode use https://dashboard.stripe.com/{{account_id}}/test/apikeys/create

chain.onMatch: exit_with_error:auth_required — sign in to Stripe first

chain.message: Not on Stripe's create-API-key page (signed out, or no developer access on this account). Nothing was changed.
This Yeshie build does not support within_row with cells, so the permission rows cannot be chosen safely. Load an extension built from current master. Nothing was changed.
